name: Jiali Chen

papers.title: RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: We present RoboKit, a performant, general-purpose toolkit that extends the value of optimization to robot learning. It is built around three principles: (i) \emph{Performance and flexibility}: implemented in a kernel-level language, it pairs multi-seed sampling with versatile optimizers. With well-tuned engineering, it runs over $10\times$ faster than prior frameworks; (ii) \emph{Geometry and rendering}: it makes geometry and differentiable rendering first-class and accelerates both with hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations. It can optimize 1024 grasps in 2\,s; (iii) \emph{Integration with learning}: every cost is differentiable and plugs directly into learning frameworks, letting us distill optimization into policies. The learned policies run significantly faster while matching or surpassing optimization performance.
